svg.aria-label: From a push on main to a reconcile in seconds: 1. Declare: The FluxInstance named flux, created by this chart, pins the distribution and the four controllers to run. 2. Sync: The source controller pulls kubernetes/clusters/main from main every hour, so Git stays the source of truth. 3. Hear: GitHub posts a push event through the public gateway. The receiver checks its token and pokes flux-system. 4. Tune: Patches add workers and memory for the kustomize, helm and source controllers, an in-memory kustomize build and an OOM watch. 5. Watch: Four rules fire when the instance is missing or not ready, or a Flux object stays suspended or not Ready too long.
